instruction: How to create a Crossplane XRD with a default value
output:
kubectl apply -f - <<< 'apiVersion: apiextensions.crossplane.io/v1
kind: CompositeResourceDefinition
metadata:
  name: xmyapps.example.crossplane.io
spec:
  group: example.crossplane.io
  names:
    kind: XMyApp
    plural: xmyapps
  claimNames:
    kind: MyApp
    plural: myapps
  versions:
  - name: v1alpha1
    served: true
    referenceable: true
    schema:
      openAPIV3Schema:
        type: object
        properties:
          spec:
            type: object
            properties:
              region:
                type: string
                default: us-east-1'

instruction: How to create a Crossplane Composition with a patch for array fields
output:
kubectl apply -f - <<< 'apiVersion: apiextensions.crossplane.io/v1
kind: Composition
metadata:
  name: with-array-patch
spec:
  compositeTypeRef:
    apiVersion: example.crossplane.io/v1alpha1
    kind: XMyApp
  resources:
  - name: my-sg
    base:
      apiVersion: ec2.aws.crossplane.io/v1beta1
      kind: SecurityGroup
    patches:
    - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
      fromFieldPath: spec.securityGroups
      toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.groupName
      policy:
        fromFieldPath: Required'

instruction: How to create a Crossplane Composition with an environment patch

instruction: How to create a Crossplane Composition that uses a function pipeline
output:
kubectl apply -f - <<< 'apiVersion: apiextensions.crossplane.io/v1
kind: Composition
metadata:
  name: pipeline-composition
spec:
  compositeTypeRef:
    apiVersion: example.crossplane.io/v1alpha1
    kind: XMyApp
  mode: Pipeline
  pipeline:
  - step: patch-and-transform
    functionRef:
      name: function-patch-and-transform
    input:
      apiVersion: pt.fn.crossplane.io/v1beta1
      kind: Resources
      spec:
        resources:
        - name: my-bucket
          base:
            apiVersion: s3.aws.crossplane.io/v1beta1
            kind: Bucket
  - step: auto-ready
    functionRef:
      name: function-auto-ready'

instruction: How to create a Crossplane Composition with a pipeline step
output: kubectl apply -f composition-pipeline-step.yaml

instruction: How to create a Crossplane Composition with a cross-resource patch
output:
kubectl apply -f - <<< 'apiVersion: apiextensions.crossplane.io/v1
kind: Composition
metadata:
  name: cross-resource-patch
spec:
  compositeTypeRef:
    apiVersion: example.crossplane.io/v1alpha1
    kind: XMyApp
  resources:
  - name: my-vpc
    base:
      apiVersion: ec2.aws.crossplane.io/v1beta1
      kind: VPC
      spec:
        forProvider:
          cidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/16
  - name: my-subnet
    base:
      apiVersion: ec2.aws.crossplane.io/v1beta1
      kind: Subnet
      spec:
        forProvider:
          cidrBlock: 10.0.1.0/24
    patches:
    - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
      fromFieldPath: status.myVpcId
      toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.vpcId
      policy:
        fromFieldPath: Optional
    - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
      fromFieldPath: spec.myVpcId
      toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.vpcId'

instruction: How to create a Crossplane XRD with a version upgrade
output:
kubectl apply -f - <<< 'apiVersion: apiextensions.crossplane.io/v1
kind: CompositeResourceDefinition
metadata:
  name: xmyapps.example.crossplane.io
spec:
  group: example.crossplane.io
  names:
    kind: XMyApp
    plural: xmyapps
  claimNames:
    kind: MyApp
    plural: myapps
  versions:
  - name: v1alpha1
    served: true
    referenceable: true
    schema:
      openAPIV3Schema:
        type: object
        properties:
          spec:
            type: object
            properties:
              region:
                type: string
  - name: v1alpha2
    served: true
    referenceable: true
    schema:
      openAPIV3Schema:
        type: object
        properties:
          spec:
            type: object
            properties:
              region:
                type: string
              replicas:
                type: integer
    conversion:
      strategy: Webhook
      webhook:
        clientConfig:
          service:
            name: crossplane-webhooks
            namespace: crossplane-system'
